lines.text: David asks the LORD not to rebuke him in anger and says his iniquities are a burden too heavy.
David mourns all day long and groans, while his friends shun his disease and his kinsmen stand far off.
Those who seek his life lay swords, yet David does not open his mouth and waits for the LORD.
David confesses his iniquity and says many enemies hate him without reason.
David asks the LORD not to forsake him and to come quickly to help, calling Him his Redeemer.
